newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields fall further on 1-month Lithuania T-bill.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall further on 1-month Lithuania T-bill.

text.p: Yields continued to fall on one-month Lithuanian T-bills at Monday's auction and the issue was oversubscribed, the country's central bank said.
The average yield at Monday's auction was 9.59 percent compared to 11.95 percent at the last auction for one-month paper on August 19.
The highest yield was 10.25 percent and the lowest was 9.00 percent. All of the 55 million litas issue was sold with total demand reaching 118 million litas.
The settlement date is September 5 and the bills mature on October 3. -- Riga newsroom +3717-22 66 93
